preconditions.description: The length of the string n is between 1 and 500000, inclusive.
The string consists of 'V', 'K', and '?' characters.

postconditions.expression: output contains the number of possible periods
postconditions.description: The first line of output contains the number of distinct periods that can be obtained by replacing '?' with 'V' or 'K'.

postconditions.expression: output contains the list of possible periods
postconditions.description: The second line of output contains all possible periods in increasing order.
